en:
Welcome to the Data Room.
Here you can check our club's results
and other information.
Check our club's match schedule.

Check information on our club's
players and on other clubs.

View the records of the J.League
and the Japan National Team.

See rankings of top players in the
J.League and around the world.

Check every J.League club's results
this year, and the year-by-year trend
in final standings.

Check the current rankings of nations
worldwide and Japan's year-by-year
ranking trend.

See how our club ranks against clubs
around the world, and the rankings
of the world's clubs.

Check our results in the tournaments
we have entered. If we have won one,
you can admire the trophy here.
The greatest records set in J1 so far.

Check the current results of all J1
and J2 clubs this year, and how they
have changed.

Check the trend in final results for
all J1 and J2 clubs.

Check the glorious, unbroken records
set by J1 clubs.

Check the unbroken, dishonourable
records set by J1 clubs.

Check the glorious, unbroken records
set by J1 players.

Our J.League results by year since
joining will appear here. Please wait
until this year's league has finished.

This year's J2 and J1 results will
appear here. Please wait until the
first J2 match of the year is over.

Check the yearly J1 goalscoring
rankings.

Check the yearly J2 goalscoring
rankings.

Rankings by position, covering
players all over the world.

Check the goalkeeper rankings for
players worldwide.

Check the defender rankings for
players worldwide.

Check the midfielder rankings for
players worldwide.

Check the forward rankings for
players worldwide.

Our club is 1st with @Y/#tk00# wins@
in a row. Well played, but this streak
won't stand forever.

Our club leads with @Y/#tk01# titles@.
But bask in the glory and a club on a
roll will overtake us.

Our club leads with @Y/#tk02# times@.
But a club with a fine defence will
beat that figure sooner or later.

Our club is 1st with @Y/#tk04# goals@.
But a total like this is bound to be
beaten before long.

Our club is last on @M/#tk05# goals@.
Let's use this as motivation to boost
our scoring power.

Our club is last with @M/#tk06# goals
conceded@. Let's use that to tighten up
at the back.

We have @M/#tk07# losses@, the worst.
Let's take this disappointment and
vow to come back stronger.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their scoring power was
greatly feared by other clubs.

The current top two are both our
players. Having J1's two best scorers
at our club is reassuring.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their scoring power was
famous throughout J1.

The current top two are both our
players. Having J2's two best scorers
at our club is reassuring.

What a year! Our @Y/%s@ was named
the world's number one "Iron Wall".
A memorable year indeed.

Right now @Y/%s@ is in first place.
I'd love to see how many goals they
can keep out against the world's best.

That year's top two were both our
players. Even the world's best would
have struggled to score against them.

The current top two are both our
players. Even world-class clubs would
find it hard to score against them.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their control of matches was
praised around the world.

The current top two are both our
players. Even world-class clubs will
struggle to dictate matches.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their scoring power could
threaten any defence in the world.

The current top two are both our
players. They look set to bag plenty
of goals against the world's best.

A list of the players at our club.
Up/Down: select a player.
A Button: view their details.

A player at our club.
Press the A Button to see this
player's evaluation.

View Hall of Fame players by position.
Left/Right: select. A Button: confirm.

A GK who was a wall for our club and
earned a place in the Hall of Fame.

earned a place in the Hall of Fame.

No GK from our club is in the Hall of
Fame yet. I hope one comes along soon
who can keep out any shot.

No defender from our club is in the
Hall of Fame yet. We need one soon who
can reliably stop opposing attacks.

No midfielder from our club is in the
Hall of Fame yet. We need a star of
the midfield battle to emerge soon.

Hall of Fame yet. I hope a prolific
scorer emerges soon.

situation. If we don't improve soon,
things will get serious.

you will be forced to resign.
